deep_read.description: مراسلة ناشر الوظيفة من شركة DARPAN - NIT DURGAPUR दर्पण - एन.आई.टी. दुर्गापुर بشكل مباشر Nijamudeen Gouri Nijamudeen Gouri Undergraduate Student at NIT Durgapur 🌟 We're Hiring: Arabic Translator / Arabic-English Translator / Translation Specialist 📍 Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote) 🕒 Employment Type: Part-Time 💼 Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior 🌐 Work Arrangement: Fully Remote About Us We are a globally connected organization supporting international communication through accurate, culturally appropriate, and high-quality language services. Our work helps businesses and professional teams communicate effectively across Arabic- and English-speaking markets through clear translation, localization, and multilingual content support. The Role We are seeking an Arabic Translator / Arabic-English Translator / Translation Specialist to support written and digital communication across Arabic and English. The role involves translating business materials, reviewing multilingual content, maintaining terminology consistency, and ensuring messages are accurate and culturally appropriate. This flexible remote opportunity is suited to a detail-oriented language professional who can manage assignments independently. Key Responsibilities Translate business, marketing, administrative, and general professional content between Arabic and English. Review translated materials for accuracy, clarity, grammar, tone, and cultural suitability. Adapt content to reflect the intended meaning and context rather than relying on literal translation. Maintain consistent terminology, style, formatting, and language quality across projects. Proofread and edit Arabic and English documents before publication or distribution. Support localization of digital content, presentations, communications, and business materials. Research terminology and subject-specific references when handling specialized content. Coordinate with internal teams, writers, managers, and other language professionals. Manage multiple translation assignments while meeting agreed deadlines. Contribute to improving translation workflows, terminology resources, and quality standards. Requirements Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Translation, Languages, Linguistics, Communications, or a related field is preferred. 3+ years of professional translation or language-related experience is preferred. Strong written and spoken proficiency in both Arabic and English. Strong understanding of Arabic and English grammar, terminology, tone, and cultural context. Knowledge of professional translation, proofreading, editing, and localization practices. Familiarity with digital documents, content management, and remote collaboration tools. Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify language inconsistencies. Ability to communicate complex information clearly and naturally in both languages.
